items.title: 1 Industrials Stock to Keep an Eye On and 2 We Turn Down
items.summary: Even if they go mostly unnoticed, industrial businesses are the backbone of our country. But they are at the whim of volatile macroeconomic factors that influence capital spending (like interest rates), and the industry has underperformed the market over the past six months as its 5% return lagged the S&P 500 by 8.3 percentage points.

items.title: U.S. links Chinese satellite imagery to deadly Iranian strike - WSJ
items.summary: Investing.com -- U.S. officials have linked high-resolution satellite imagery supplied to Iran by Chinese entities to a July missile strike on a U.S. base in Jordan that killed three American troops, the Wall Street Journal reported exclusively on Friday.
